name: Elan The Emperor
summary: Existence, developer, Sector 106 Dwarka Expressway location, RERA GGM/902/634/2025/05, September 2032 RERA completion date, ₹12.99 Cr starting price, 4/5 BHK sizes, 5 towers and 580 units are confirmed. Our 50-acre land area is far larger than the 4.827 acres filed with RERA (24.10-acre licensed parcel), although Square Yards also states 50 acres. Our 5 BHK size of 5,444 sq ft differs from the 5,434 sq ft on portals.

checks.web: Elan The Emperor, luxury residential project, Sector 106, Gurgaon
Elan Group; promoter Elan Avenue Limited (formerly Airmid Developers Limited)
checks.note: Our developer label 'Elan The Emperor' is the project name, not the developer (cosmetic).

checks.ours: Sector 106, Dwarka Expressway, Sector 106, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 106, Village Pawala Khusrupur, Dwarka Expressway, Gurgaon

checks.note: RERA-GRG-1774-2024 is the application/project ID; the registration certificate number matches ours.
Reportedly the developer is targeting an earlier phased handover (around late 2029).

checks.web: ₹12.99 Cr (Square Yards); about ₹11.19 Cr base (reratracker); ₹9.99-10 Cr (broker sites)
checks.note: Square Yards matches exactly, and reratracker is within 15%. Some broker pages advertise ₹10 Cr onwards. Our value lacks the ₹ symbol (cosmetic).

checks.ours: 4 BHK — 4,223 sq ft — Price on Request | 4 BHK — 4,640 sq ft — Price on Request | 4 BHK — 7,225 sq ft — Price on Request | 4 BHK — 8,053 sq ft — Price on Request | 5 BHK — 5,444 sq ft — Price on Request | 5 BHK — 5,891 sq ft — Price on Request | 5 BHK — 9,470 sq ft — Price on Request | 5 BHK — 10,347 sq ft — Price on Request
checks.web: 4 BHK 4,223-4,640; 5 BHK 5,434-5,891; 4 BHK penthouse 7,225-8,053; 5 BHK penthouse 9,470-10,347 sq ft (super area)
checks.note: All sizes match except our 5 BHK 5,444 sq ft, which sources give as 5,434 sq ft (possible typo). We do not label the 7,225-10,347 sq ft units as penthouses.

checks.web: 4.827 acres registered (within a 24.10-acre licensed parcel) per RERA tracker; 50 acres (Square Yards); 33.5-37 acres (broker sites)
checks.note: Sources disagree widely. The RERA-based figure is 4.827 acres. 50 acres likely refers to Elan's wider Sector 106 township, not this project.

checks.web: 5 buildings, 580 units, up to 45 floors (RERA tracker); 580 units in 2 towers of 39 floors (Square Yards)
checks.note: Square Yards says 2 towers, which conflicts with the RERA tracker's 5. One broker snippet claims 1,800 units.
